note: City of Pawnee City campground on the city fishing pond (the 'Pawnderosa'), with concrete pads on a loop west of the pond. No host on site: reserve and pay at City Hall. Camper reviews report 30/50-amp pedestals, a pull-through (site 6), and no showers or dump station; the concrete restroom/storm shelter is new. Reviewers have fit a 33-ft Class A; some smaller sites won't take big rigs. Fishing pond and pier, picnic areas. --Claude
summary: City page read today: concrete pads, $15 water + electric, $8 tent, reservation required by phone to City Hall (402-852-2781), new restroom/storm shelter. Water, booking and fees now manual. Review-only derived values cleared (50 A, pull-through, no showers, no dump), kept as camper-reported text in the note. Pin OK. Pond confirmed (~2 acres).
